events.region: Southwest Utah; Lower Washington County; Zion National Park; Southern Mountains; Upper Sevier River Valleys; Bryce Canyon Country; South Central Utah
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
The Flash Flood Watch for Saturday is cancelled for a portion of
Utah, including the following areas, Bryce Canyon Country, South
Central Utah, Southern Mountains, Upper Sevier River Valleys, Lower
Washington County, Southwest Utah and Zion National Park.

Flooding is no longer expected to pose a threat as rain has tapered
off across the area. Please continue to heed remaining road closures.

events.summary:
At 1039 PM CDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm near
Champion, moving east at 15 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 40 mph and pea size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor hail damage to vegetation is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Sweetwater, Roscoe, Maryneal, Wastella, Champion, The Intersection Of
Highway 70 And Ranch Road 53, Lake Sweetwater, The Intersection Of
Ranch Road 608 And Highway 147, Camp Boothe Oaks, Us-
84 Near The Nolan-Fisher County Line, and I-20 Near The Nolan-
Mitchell County Line.

This includes Interstate 20 between Mile Markers 229 and 253.

events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
FFWMAF

The National Weather Service in Midland/Odessa has extended the

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Eastern Mitchell County in western Texas...
South Central Scurry County in western Texas...

* Until 1145 PM CDT.

* At 1031 PM CDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 2 and 4.5 inches of rain
have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts up to 1 inch are possible
in portions of the warned area. Flash flooding is already
occurring.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Colorado City, Loraine, Champion Creek Reservoir, Lake Colorado
City, Lake Colorado City State Park, Colorado City Airport,
Westbrook, Buford and Dunn.

events.summary:
FFWABQ

The National Weather Service in Albuquerque has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Central Chaves County in southeastern New Mexico...

* Until 1145 PM MDT.

* At 930 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 1.25 and 2.75 inches of
rain have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts up to 0.75 inches are
possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected
to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Southern Roswell. Draws, washes, and arroyos feeding into the Rio
Hondo and Rio Felix will observe flash flooding.

This includes Highway 285 between Mile Markers 96 and 104.

Nantucket Sound...
Ocean Waters from Provincetown to Nantucket from 20 to 60 NM...

events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Western Nolan County in west central Texas...

* WHEN...Until 1215 AM CDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 1019 PM CDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Between 0.5 and 1.5 inches of rain
have fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts of 0.5 to 1 inch are expected over
the area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Roscoe, Champion, Wastella, I-20 Near The Nolan-Mitchell County
Line and Us-84 Near The Nolan-Fisher County Line.
- This includes Interstate 20 between Mile Markers 229 and 237.

This includes the following Low Water Crossings...
County Road 137 crossing South Fork Champion Creek and County
Road 133 crossing Plum Creek.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
